text: A separate run, outside the small duration-testing model, tries to book a room that is already reserved. The component returns the existing reservation's ID. It does not report a conflict, and it does not create a second reservation. The brief had not described this behavior. Explain whether your duration tests check this situation. Then revise what a successful call must guarantee (the postcondition), or request written rules for this case.
